collisionReconciliation.notes: The first real full beta build exposed five collisions because existing derived collision data is v1.0-only. Reconcile its six exact suppressed routes in module configuration, rather than broadening the original operation-ID regex. The published MgCommandMetadata.json oracle contains no exact method/path row for any of these routes in either profile. Both profiles retain GET /groups/{group-id}/calendar/calendarView (Get-Mg[Beta]GroupCalendarView), GET /users/{user-id}/calendar/calendarView (Get-Mg[Beta]UserCalendarView), and POST /users/{user-id}/calendar/permanentDelete (Remove-Mg[Beta]UserCalendarPermanent). Neither profile publishes a user calendar event count route. The default-calendar permanentDelete beta verb/noun remains a pre-existing structural parity difference outside the shared rename directive; it is not suppressed. Regression coverage checks real spec IDs, oracle absence, existing derived provenance, exact suppression, retained neighbors and successful subset emission.
